newsitem.title: USA: BG&E Md. nuke resumes power production Wed.
newsitem.headline: BG&E Md. nuke resumes power production Wed.

text.p: Baltimore Gas and Electric Co's 850 megawatt (MW) Calvert Cliffs 2 nuclear unit, which automatically tripped off line this past weekend, has resumed power production, the company said early Wednesday.
"We resumed generating electricity at 0630 (EST) this morning. As of 0800 (EST), we were at 20 percent power," said company spokesman Karl Neddenien.
He could not estimate when the unit would return to full power.
The Lusby, Md., unit shut down due to a problem in a feedwater regulating valve.
